answer:
**Answer: ≈52 CHIP variants per sample (mean 52.3, n=86 samples)** after filtering out intronic, intergenic, and UTR variants — i.e., counting each sample's unique called (Heterozygous or Homozygous Variant) variants in the CHIP panel whose Sequence Ontology term is not intron_variant, 3'/5' UTR (incl. the 5'UTR start-gain term), or upstream_gene_variant, with splice_region_variant kept.

Full executed analysis summary (script: analysis/chip_variant_analysis.py; per-sample table: analysis/per_sample_chip_variant_counts.csv):

Pipeline over all 86 workbooks (57,258 data rows total):
- Excluded 44,211 "Reference" (wildtype) rows and 1,151 blank/no-call zygosity rows (including the ~538 no-call rows in each of 380-P and 381-PM) → 11,896 alternate-called rows.
- Collapsed 5 duplicate (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) rows → 11,891 unique called variants.
- SO filter removed 7,394 unique variants (intron/UTR/upstream) → 4,497 kept variants (composition: synonymous 2,938, missense 1,035, splice_region 437, frameshift 78, inframe_insertion 8, inframe_deletion 1).

Primary result: mean 52.29 unique CHIP variants/sample (median 52, range 39–66, SD 6.0).

Sensitivity figures (per your instructions):
- Excluding splice_region_variant as well: mean 47.21 (~47).
- Row-count basis instead of unique variants: identical mean 52.29 (duplicated rows were all in excluded intron/Reference categories).
- 380-P/381-PM no-call anomaly: their kept counts (51 and 46) are normal; mean without those two samples = 52.38 (n=84) vs 52.29 with all 86 — negligible effect because the anomaly inflated their total row counts, not their called-variant counts.

Assumptions stated: (1) only samples' actual alternate genotype calls count; Reference and blank-zygosity rows excluded; (2) splice_region_variant retained in the primary number (distinct SO term, not literally "intronic") with the no-splice sensitivity shown; (3) upstream_gene_variant treated as intergenic-adjacent and excluded; no rows carry an explicit intergenic_variant label; (4) no re-application of the 56-gene list (In_CHIP=True on all 57,258 rows; the export is already CHIP-restricted) and no trio-status stratification — all 86 workbooks are the denominator; (5) unique variants keyed by (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt). Limitations: trio sample 533 has no workbook (86 files vs 87 trio entries, doesn't affect counting); DP10/GQ20/Pass filtering is inherited from the supplied files.

payload.primary_answer: 52.3 unique CHIP variants per sample (mean over 86 samples; ~52)
